A super easy, healthy breakfast loaded with veggies, where the entire batter comes together in a chopper in just 5 minutes. I serve it a little differently, inspired by the way Japanese Okonomiyaki is served, with a delicious sauce and a topping of creamy Greek yogurt.
It’s wholesome, filling, and a great breakfast for the whole family. Do give this fun twist on a classic cheela a try, the full written recipe is in the description below, Happy Cooking!
